shellRecipe:
git clone https://github.com/libtmux/libtmux-lua.git libtmux-source &&
  git -C libtmux-source checkout 0395620d362ef75c74cd488f9577afda68922586 &&
  luarocks --tree ./rocks install luv 1.52.1-0 &&
  (cd libtmux-source &&
    luarocks --tree ../rocks make rockspecs/libtmux-scm-1.rockspec) &&
  eval "$(luarocks --tree ./rocks path)"

eval "$(luarocks --tree ./rocks path)" &&
  sh run.sh connect.lua
